In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (19.915 hours/week = 50%) January 01, 2027, we are looking for a

Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d)

The Department of Health Services Research at the Institute of Diversity Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, Ruhr University Bochum, Germany, is seeking to appoint a Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d) starting 1st of January 2027. The Department of Health Services Research investigates how individual diversity characteristics influence healthcare delivery and develops, implements, and evaluates innovative, patient-centred models of care. Our research focuses on the evaluation of complex interventions, participatory health services research, and the development of diversity-sensitive healthcare concepts. Our interdisciplinary work integrates health services research, public health, social sciences, and medical ethics.

The successful candidate will join the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Programme DIME – Diversity Medicine, an international initiative to establish a new joint Master's programme together with leading European and international partner universities (e.g. France, Japan, Taiwan). This position offers the unique opportunity to contribute to the development of an innovative international degree programme at the intersection of diversity medicine, global health, and higher education. As Research Associate / Project Coordinator, you will play a central role in coordinating this international consortium. You will collaborate closely with academic partners, university leadership, teaching staff, students, and funding organisations across several countries. The position requires excellent English proficiency, strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills, and outstanding organisational abilities to successfully coordinate complex international collaborations.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 15 Monate
Start: January 01, 2027
Apply by:  2026-09-28

Your tasks:

- Contribute to the scientific development and evaluation of the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Programme DIME - Diversity Medicine, including literature reviews and the preparation of scientific materials
- Support the collection, analysis and interpretation of data related to teaching, programme evaluation and research activities within DIME
- Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and the dissemination of research findings
- support the coordination of academic activities within DIME, including communication with partner universities, students and visiting academics
- Assist in organising consortium meetings, workshops and selected international programme activities conducted in English
- Contribute to project documentation, reporting and the preparation of presentations and other project materials

Your profile:

- Master's degree (or equivalent university qualification) in Public Health, Health Sciences, Medicine, Health Services Research, Social Sciences, Psychology, Medical Ethics, Higher Education Management, or a related field
- Strong interest in diversity medicine, international higher education, and collaborative research
- A very good command of written and spoken English is essential, as English is the working language of the consortium and virtually all communication is conducted in English
- Excellent communication, networking, and interpersonal skills
- Outstanding diplomatic skills, intercultural competence, and confidence in working with partners from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to independently manage complex international coordination processes
- Highly structured, proactive, solution-oriented, and reliable working style with a strong sense of responsibility
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within an international team
- Experience in international project management, Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus, university administration, or comparable international projects is desirable
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

jobs.occupation: Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry (Analytiker/in - Chemie)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for a

Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry

At the Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II of the Ruhr University Bochum we address research questions in the fields of organometallic synthesis chemistry and homogeneous catalysis. We are an internationally oriented research team that develops new reagents as well as highly efficient catalysts for synthetic chemistry. By combining advanced synthetic methods, state of the art analytical techniques, quantum chemical calculations, and machine learning methods, we conduct world leading research at the highest international level. Automated analysis of chemical data and the prediction of reactivity, selectivity and yield by means of machine learning are revolutionising modern chemistry. In our group we employ data science methods together with quantum chemical calculations to model reaction networks from experimental data, understand bonding situations and reactivities, and identify new catalysts and reaction conditions in a data driven way.

The Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II (Organometallic Chemistry and Homogeneous Catalysis) is looking for a full time scientific staff member (postdoctoral researcher) (100 % TV L 13) to start immediately. We are looking for a motivated postdoctoral researcher (m/f/x) who, with a passion for interdisciplinary work, will support the design of teaching courses in data science and machine learning and strengthen our group in this area.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 Jahre
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-21

Your tasks:

- Quantum‑chemical calculations – perform calculations to elucidate reaction mechanisms, bonding situations and to extract physicochemical properties of molecules
- Model development & validation – create and validate models that clarify structure‑activity relationships and predict properties and reactivities; analyse data with statistical methods and visualise the results
- Collaboration with experimentalists – work closely with laboratory scientists to support and validate data collection
- Project leadership – take responsibility for projects, supervise students, write reports and grant proposals
- Scientific communication – compile results into publications and assist students in preparing manuscripts
- Mentorship – supervise students in their theses and support teaching activities in the areas of Data Science and Machine Learning
- Teaching – support the development and implementation of new student courses in Data Science and Machine Learning

Your profile:

A candidate with a completed university degree and a PhD (preferred) in Chemistry is sought; candidates from related fields such as Data Science or Computer Science with demonstrable knowledge of chemistry are also welcome.

Further requirements:

- Practical experience in quantum‑chemical calculations – familiarity with common quantum‑chemical programs and methods, in particular ORCA, Multiwfn, AIM, etc.
- Practical experience in machine learning & chemistry‑specific data science – programming skills in Python and hands‑on experience with standard libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Scikit‑learn, RDKit, PyTorch, etc.
- Practical experience in homogeneous catalysis – desirable, but not mandatory
- Practical experience with the installation and maintenance of high-performance computing clusters – desirable, but not mandatory
- Theoretical knowledge in quantum-chemistry, machine learning, molecular chemistry
- Experience in research project management
- Experience in publishing and presenting scientific results
- Experience in teaching and the supervision of students and interns
- Language skills – English (fluent spoken and written) is required; German is an advantage but not mandatory

Furthermore, the applicant should be open to team‑oriented work and possess a strong motivation for interdisciplinary research.

jobs.description:
Your missionResponsibilities
• Design, plan, and execute research activities within early and advanced projects, e.g analysis and interpretation of data to support target validation and candidate profiling – including benchwork as needed
• Provide guidance and functional leadership to technicians, including supervision of experimental work
• Identify scientific challenges and propose solutions or alternative approaches
• Integrate internal and external data (e.g. literature, databases, experimental results) to generate insights supporting project decisions
• Initiate and coordinate research collaborations with academic partners, CROs, and external experts
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (e.g. research, clinical, regulatory) to ensure alignment of activities with project goals
• Contribute to the evaluation of external opportunities, including participation in due diligence activities
• Support resource planning and coordination of activities within assigned projects
• Present data in internal and external meetings and conferences as a speaker and representative of AiCuris
• Prepare and contribute to scientific documents, including research reports, publications, patents, and regulatory documents

Your profileSkills and Qualification
• Education : PhD in (Molecular) Virology or a related discipline, with at least 2 years of experience in antiviral research and/or drug discovery within an academic or industry-based virology laboratory
• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with virology laboratory methods and technologies
• Ability to design and conduct experiments to address project relevant questions based on relevant scientific and patent literature
• Hands-on experience relevant state of the art scientific software, including sequence analysis and scientific data analysis software, such as Geneious Prime and GraphPad Prism, or comparable tools
• Strong commitment to scientific rigor, data integrity, and thorough documentation of experimental work
• Proven ability to independently manage research projects and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams, while providing scientific guidance, mentoring, and technical support to laboratory staff
• Willingness to learn and apply regulatory (GCP/GLP/GMP, FDA/EMA regulations) and quality assurance (QA) requirements into work practices as needed.
• Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex tasks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Very good communication skills with the ability to present complex data clearly. Collaborative team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. High level of personal motivation and ownership
• Languages: Excellent written and verbal English; in addition, German language skills (at least B1 level) are considered essential, as the role involves regular interaction with technicians who may prefer communication in German.

Why us?What we offer
• Unique corporate culture: Scientific excellence, a collaborative working environment and the passion to improve the lives of patients defines our work. With us, you can work together with innovation awarded experts with the proven ability to translate science into commercial success. You can expect diversity, inspiration as well as trustful collaboration.
• Development: We encourage people to grow and strongly support individual development and learning opportunities.
• Flexibility: Embracing flexible working accommodations, we enable our people to integrate business into their personal life.
• Benefits: Employer-funded pension comes along with an attractive benefits package

About usAiCuris is meeting the needs of the growing population of immunocompromised people who require precise therapies to effectively treat infection. Our flagship product, PREVYMIS, marketed by our partner MSD, treats CMV in a defined group of transplant recipients. Our pivotal phase 3 candidate Pritelivir aims to address recurrent and resistant HSV infections in a broad population of patients with weakened immune systems. For immunocompromised people, an otherwise manageable infection can mean life or death. AiCuris, with its expertise and growing pipeline, is committed to providing therapeutic solutions for them now and in the future.We believe in a culture of trust and transparency, where feedback is considered an opportunity to contribute to each other's personal and professional growth. We hire people who are collaborative, adaptable, communicate well, and love to learn.
*AiCuris is an employer that supports equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people regardless of their national origin, skin color, religion, gender, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
Tasks & responsibilities

- Design and prepare clinical development plans, focusing on Phase I, II, and III in oncology indications.
- Guide cross-functional teams as the clinical lead, including experts from clinical trial operations, regulatory, medical affairs, preclinical & clinical pharmacology, biostatistics, biomarkers, and patient safety to ensure high-quality execution.
- Oversee the setup, conduct, and data readout of clinical trials together with the Clinical Trial Lead, ensuring timelines, quality, and ethical standards are met.
- Provide input to regulatory strategy and clinical components of briefing documents, presentations, and responses to regulatory questions.
- Contribute to the Medical Affairs strategy and deliverables, such as the Integrated Evidence Plan, in collaboration with Medical Advisor(s) and the Medical Affairs Lead.
- Evaluate external opportunities using your clinical expertise to support decisions that strengthen the pipeline.

Additional tasks for the Senior Role:

- Supervise and mentor other Clinical Program Leads in the assigned program/asset.
- Shape the overarching development strategy for the program in alignment with Indication and Brand Teams, including marketing and market access.
- Initiate external collaborations with academic and industrial partners.

Requirements

- MD degree with several years of clinical and scientific experience in oncology
- Few years of experience in clinical drug development within the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent experience in academic clinical research
- Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups
- Skilled in presenting scientific content and facilitating cross-functional discussions
- High level of initiative, strategic thinking, and team orientation
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Additional requirements for the Senior Role:

- MD degree with long-standing clinical and scientific experience in oncology
- Several years of experience in clinical drug development within the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent experience in academic clinical research
- Strong Leadership skills with the ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.

Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until October 31, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.
Step 2: Virtual meeting mid of September
Step 3: Panel interviews end of September
Please submit your application documents in English.

You are also required to participate in network-wide improvement initiatives and implement standards created elsewhere in the network. As the RME Manager, you will be a key member of the wider RME team, responsible for ensuring that our equipment and systems operate safely, efficiently, and with minimal downtime. You will lead a team of experienced professionals and collaborate with cross-functional teams across your network to optimize equipment performance and reduce costs. - Relevant experience of Engineering team leadership.

- Multi skilled in both electrical and mechanical disciplines.
- Ability to communicate (written & verbal) in English and the local language.

- Demonstrated experience in project management.
- Comprehensive knowledge of specialized engineering and facilities equipment within the Fulfillment Center, as well as maintenance and safety procedures.
- Experience working with PLC based control systems.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Additional information

At TK Elevator, we aim to embrace diversity and welcome everyone -no matter the ethnicity, nationality, gender or gender expression, age, social background, religion or world belief, sexual orientation, disability, marital status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. 
Do you have a disability and would like to work with us? Then we look forward to your application! 
As a signatory of the Charter of Diversity, TK Elevator is committed to a prejudice-free and diverse working environment with equal opportunities. Although we are not completely barrier-free yet, we are working every day to improve ourselves. Let’s overcome barriers together and work on individual solutions that work for you.
